message.content: In the conversation, Jareth expressed a fondness for engaging with the camp in Red Dead Redemption 2, describing it as a way to connect with the characters and create memorable moments. Specifically, he mentioned one night when Dutch, a member of the gang, told a story that sent chills down his spine, tying into the game's overarching themes and showcasing the depth of the characters' backgrounds and relationships. This interaction exemplified how the camp evolved and added more depth to the narrative, making the experience feel more alive. While no particular side mission was highlighted by Jareth, this anecdote underscores the richness of the camp interactions within the game.
